as_told.title: Jack Parsons' past life as Simon the Sorcerer

plain: The rocket engineer Jack Parsons is said to have done a past-life regression, an attempt to recall supposed earlier lives, and found that he had been Simon the Sorcerer, a magician from early Christian stories. Michels tells this himself, and elsewhere explains that Parsons belonged to the OTO, an occult order linked to the occultist Aleister Crowley, where such regressions were done. It ties one of America's rocket pioneers to the occult.
